native_comparison.limitations: Source crops are selected presentation regions, not proof of unchanged pixels or botanical/architectural accuracy. Original source-tree name/prototype allocation can differ across native processes; separate native preservation records apply. The paving window is projected between ground Z=0 and the retained courtyard cap height; this frames the region, not an occlusion measurement. Metadata inputs are historical file fingerprints, not recursively embedded metadata or active temporary artifacts. Native protection and human visual inspection are separate gates. No reference parity is claimed.
